name: SVC_AP_ACT_ATTRS_INT
description: This table contains the attributes to be set when creating or updating the entity object of an action.

columns.name: ACTION_ATTRIBUTE_ID
columns.description: The value to this column is filled during enrichment.

columns.name: ACTION_ID
columns.description: Foreign key that references SVC_AP_ACTIONS.ACTION_ID,This will enriched

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_NAME
columns.description: Attribute from the entity object of the associated action.

columns.name: USAGE_CD
columns.description: Lookup code that indicates when the attribute is to be used.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_VALUE_CONTEXT_CD
columns.description: The context of how the attribute value should be interpreted (for example, as an attribute of the parent action's object, an attribute of the parent action, or a custom value).

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_VALUE
columns.description: Value to set on the action attribute.

columns.name: DELETED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the action attribute is logically deleted (Y or N).

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.description: For each run of the job, import wizard generates a new batch id and this batch id will be used uniquely.

columns.name: INTERFACE_ROW_ID
columns.description: Used to link this record with the error record.

columns.name: FILE_RECORD_NUM
columns.description: This column is required by import wizard to relate record in the interface table to the file row.

columns.name: ERROR_MESSAGE
columns.description: This is an optional column and would be useful if consumers want any error message as the first error.

columns.name: IMPORT_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: This column indicates import wizard if the import to base table was successful or Erorred out.

columns.name: FILE_NAME_SYSTASK_ID
columns.description: This column is required for bulk import operations.

columns.name: ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Action code will be used to determine what operation should be done: insert,update,delete.

columns.name: INTERNAL_ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Internal action code will be populated internally by framework based on outcome of match step.

columns.name: INTERNAL_OVN
columns.description: The Object Version Number of the record being updated. Used for Optimistic Locking as part of Incremental Update.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: ACTION_OSR
columns.description: This is used for enriching the action during import.
